entities.name: System Information Block 19
entities.description: System Information Block 19 containing NTN synchronization parameters including epochTime and ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration.

entities.name: NTN UL Synchronization Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE instructs lower layers to start or restart NTN uplink synchronization validity duration based on SIB19 parameters.

entities.name: ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration
entities.description: Timer indicating the validity duration for NTN uplink synchronization, started or restarted from the subframe indicated by epochTime.

entities.name: epochTime
entities.description: Information element in SIB19 indicating the specific subframe from which ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration should be started.

entities.name: SIB19 Reception Condition
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE receives SIB19, initiating the NTN UL synchronization procedure.

relations.description: Reception of SIB19 triggers the NTN UL synchronization procedure.
The NTN synchronization procedure starts the ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration timer.
The NTN synchronization procedure can restart the ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration timer.
SIB19 contains the epochTime information element.
The NTN synchronization procedure uses epochTime to determine the starting subframe for ntn-UlSyncValidityDuration.
